official_sources.title: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model DTM 1m
LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model DTM 2m
Removal of Esri Image Services and open standards replacement

verified_contracts: Composite DTM models bare-earth terrain after removing surface objects
1m and 2m products cover approximately 99 percent of England rather than every location
composite production combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys
repeat coverage uses the newest best-resolution survey available
resampling before merge uses bilinear interpolation where required
composite survey lineage spans multiple acquisition dates and must be read from metadata indexes
DTM is distinct from DSM and first-return surface products
Esri Image Services were replaced by open-standard WCS and WMS delivery
WCS provides elevation coverage while WMS is a visual summary
exact numeric promotion requires candidate-specific coverage bytes metadata datum NoData and cell readback
